title: Schr\"odinger's Navigator: Imagining an Ensemble of Futures for Zero-Shot Object Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2512.21201v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Zero-shot object navigation (ZSON) requires robots to find target objects in unseen environments without task-specific fine-tuning or pre-built maps, a key capability for general-purpose service robots. Yet methods that perform well in simulation often degrade in cluttered real-world scenes with severe occlusion and latent hazards, where large unseen regions make single-scene inference brittle and unsafe. We propose Schr\"odinger's Navigator, a belief-aware framework that reasons at inference time over multiple trajectory-conditioned imagined 3D futures. Given candidate paths, a trajectory-conditioned 3D world model predicts hypothetical observations and maintains a superposition of plausible scene realizations rather than committing to one map. An adaptive occluder-aware sampler directs imagination to uncertainty-critical regions, while a Future-Aware Value Map (FAVM) aggregates imagined futures for robust, proactive action se

translated_title: 薛定谔导航器：为零样本物体导航想象一组未来场景
translated_abstract: 零样本物体导航（ZSON）要求机器人在未见过的环境中寻找目标物体，而无需任务特定的微调或预先构建的地图，这是通用服务机器人的一项关键能力。然而，在仿真中表现良好的方法，在充满杂物、严重遮挡和潜在危险的真实场景中往往性能下降——大片未见区域使得基于单一场景的推理变得脆弱且不安全。我们提出薛定谔导航器，这是一个信念感知框架，能够在推理时对多条轨迹条件下的多个想象三维未来进行推理。给定候选路径，轨迹条件的三维世界模型预测假设性观测，并维持多种合理场景实现的“叠加态”，而不是固守单一地图。自适应的遮挡感知采样器将想象引导至不确定性关键的区域，而未来感知价值图（FAVM）则聚合想象出的未来，以实现稳健、主动的行动选择。
tldr: 该论文提出“薛定谔导航器”框架，利用轨迹条件的三维世界模型在推理时想象并维持多个可能未来场景的叠加态，结合遮挡感知采样和未来感知价值图（FAVM），显著提升机器人在复杂真实环境中零样本物体导航的鲁棒性、主动性与安全性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Schrödinger's Navigator, a belief-aware framework that maintains a superposition of imagined 3D futures via a trajectory-conditioned world model and aggregates them into a Future-Aware Value Map (FAVM), enabling robust and proactive zero-shot object navigation in cluttered real-world environments.
